app.name: Meetingtime
app.tagline: Self-hosted real-time web app that helps you run better meetings by tracking speaking time and time spent on each topic, with collaborative note-taking.
home.subtitle: An app that helps you run better meetings by tracking speaking time and time spent on each topic, with collaborative note-taking.
host.title: Create a meeting
host.plannedDurationHint: Set an expected duration (in minutes) for the meeting. The global timer fills progressively from bottom to top and shifts from green to orange to red as it approaches or passes the planned end. The meeting is never stopped automatically.
host.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank for an open meeting
host.passwordHint: Set a password if you want new participants to enter it before joining. Participants reconnecting via an existing session are not asked again.
host.timeboxHint: Set a target duration (in minutes) for each speaking turn. The host can turn this limit on or off at any time during the meeting. While enforced, the current speaker's timer progressively shifts from green to orange to red, and a discreet audio warning signals when the target is exceeded. Speaking is never cut off automatically.
host.importHint: Pre-fills the fields from an existing template.
join.title: Join a meeting
join.idHint: The ID is a unique 9-character code in the XXXX-XXXX format (for example MRX7-92AB) that the meeting host shared with you.
join.resumeHint: A session for this meeting already exists on this device.
join.passwordHint: The password the host shared with you. Leave blank if your meeting doesn't require one.
meeting.inviteHint: You're the only one here so far.
meeting.agendaEmpty: No topics on the agenda yet.
meeting.agendaEmptyHost: No topics on the agenda yet.
meeting.exportNotesPrompt: The meeting has ended. Would you like to export the notes now?
meeting.connDisconnected: Offline. Changes will not be sent until the connection is restored.
notes.title: Notes
notes.readonly: Only hosts can edit these notes; they are read-only for other participants.
notes.placeholder: Write your notes here in Markdown.
notes.placeholderReadOnly: Notes written by hosts appear here.
export.title: Meeting on {date}
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.altEnter: Start, resume or pause the meeting
shortcuts.ctrlB: Collapse or expand the notes panel
shortcuts.space: Start or stop speaking for the selected participant
shortcuts.shiftSpace: Start or stop the selected topic
share.title: Share meeting
share.intro: Copy this info to share with your participants.
a11y.themeToggle: Switch between light and dark mode
a11y.notesPanelToggle: Collapse or expand the notes panel
errors.invalid_token: Session expired. Please join the meeting again.
errors.participant_cap_reached: This meeting has reached its participant limit.
errors.topic_cap_reached: This meeting has reached its topic limit.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.meeting_ended: The meeting has ended; this action is no longer available.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
